Role: Associate Software Engineer (Campus Graduate Hiring)
Requirements:
- B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Circuit branches (2025/2026 Batch)
- Entry-level / Fresher position (0 years of experience)
- Strong foundation in Data Structures & Algorithms, Java, Python, SQL, and DBMS
- Strong problem solving capabilities and academic fundamentals
Nice to have:
- Familiarity with Git, Web Development, and Operating Systems is preferred
- Good communication skills and eagerness to learn
